A HEARING WAS REQUIRED TO MAKE A DISCLOSURE. JUDGE BUSCH MADE A DISCLOSURE ABOUT HIS WIFE, CATHERINE BARNES, A DEPUTY CITY ATTORNEY NOT INVOLVED IN THIS CASE AND THAT HE DOES NOT VIEW HER EMPLOYMENT AS A BASIS FOR RECUSAL. THE COURT DIRECTED THE CLERK TO ADVISE THE PARTIES OF THE DISCLOSURE AS A RESULT OF THEM NOT APPEARING AT THE HEARING AS REQUESTED IN THE TENTATIVE RULING. THE COURT CONTINUED THE HEARING TO 6/14/11 FOR OPPOSING PARTY TO PROVIDE DEPT. 301 WITH COURTESY COPIES OF THE OPPOSITION PAPERS FILED 5/13/11 PER LOCAL RULE 2.6(B) NO LATER THAN 6/8/11. THE CASE IS BARRED BY RES JUDICATA. TO THE EXTENT PLAINTIFF'S CLAIMS ARISE FROM HIS CLAIMED RIGHTS AS A BOND HOLDER THEY ARE IN ANY EVENT BARRED BY APPLICABLE STATUTES OF LIMITATION. TO THE EXTENT ANY CLAIMS ARE BASED ON PERSONAL TORTS, PLAINTIFF HAS NOT FILED A TORT CLAIM AND, IN ANY EVENT HAS NOT STATED A BASIS FOR SUCH A CLAIM OR SUGGESTED ANY FACTS HE COULD PLEAD THAT WOULD STATE SUCH A CLAIM.
